liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mexicali Blues** (1 review): Reviewer asks about the Sugar Shack, which was played in this stretch of the first set [18]
- **Candyman** (1 review): Reviewer highlights Candyman, Dire Wolf, Row Jimmy and Me & Bobby McGee as great leftovers [17]
- **Here Comes Sunshine** (1 review): Reviewer judges this the best Here Comes Sunshine [11]
- **Playing in the Band** (1 review): The reviewer singles out the Playing in the Band performance as fantastic [9]
- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodeloo** (1 review): Reviewer praises the transition out of Mississippi Half-Step into Bobby McGee [17]
- **Weather Report Suite** (1 review): Reviewer judges this the best Weather Report Suite, and also the best Nobody's Fault But Mine [11]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Dick's Picks 1 jam among the top moments in Dead jamming, slow-building with Jerry transcendent [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **Remember your hippie training**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **audience: they're smoking a joint**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **audience**: rare: 12 archived performances [21]
- **Bass Solo/Jam**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **Feedback/Space**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-12-19.126124.mtx.dusborne.droncit.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 29 songs; 229 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd73-12-19.aud.clugston.8602.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 28 songs; 216 min; rated 4.5/5 by 10 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer rates it for the performance, not the recording quality, which is rough from stealth taping; Audience quality isn't great but is listenable [12][14]
- **gd1973-12-19.178707.sbd.patched.flegel.flac1644**: soundboard; 25 songs; 226 min [3]
- **gd1973-12-19.107984.sbd.dan.patch-97361.flac16**: soundboard; 26 songs; 207 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [4]
- **gd73-12-19.sbd.finney.outtakes.197.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 12 songs; 73 min; rated 4.73/5 by 11 [7]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says the band lost the horns when they reached the south [18]
- Longer audience, tuning and announcement portions are split into separate tracks so listeners can skip them [1]
- Dick's Picks 1 shows the band at their jazziest in late 1973; these leftovers complete the show [10]
- Unlike Dick's Picks 1, this tape includes the bass solo, the opening speech, and a few extra songs [12]
- Reviewer calls the disc a must for owners of Dick's Picks 1 [13]
- Dick's Picks 1 is recommended for a great-sounding second set; the audience tape is the cheaper alternative [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-12-19.126124.mtx.dusborne.droncit.flac16**: source: Matrix from sources: soundboard: 97361; and Dan McDonald's audience tape (new flat transfer) [1]
- **gd73-12-19.aud.clugston.8602.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Dan McDonald; source: Audience Recording [2]. Also: Reviewer patched material cut from Dick's Picks 1 using this rough audience tape; Taped by stealth, watching for roadies and cops; reviewer says this is from their own tape [11][12]
- **gd1973-12-19.178707.sbd.patched.flegel.flac1644**: source: Patched soundboard by Brian Flegel [3]. Also: Brian Flegel patched the Charlie Miller master reel source with the Clugston audience tape, adjusting speed and pitch to match [3]
- **gd1973-12-19.107984.sbd.dan.patch-97361.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; Dan; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) [4]. Also: Audience source: Sony EMC-22 mic into mono cassette on TDK SD C90s, then Tascam 112 and M-Audio Audiophile [4]
- **gd73-12-19.sbd.finney.outtakes.197.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [7]. Also: Reviewer added these leftover tracks to their Dick's Picks file to assemble the complete show [9]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Dave's Picks Vol. 58: Curtis Hixon Hall, Tampa, FL 12/18/73](https://store.dead.net/products/daves-picks-vol-58-curtis-hixon-hall-tampa-fl-12-18-73) [22]
- Poster by Bob Marks Grateful Dead: [1973-12-19 Curtis Hixon Convention Hall, Tampa, FL, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1973-12-19-curtis-hixon-convention-hall-tampa-fl-usa/) [23]
